summary: Friday's close was driven by a firming dollar and rising real yields, which pressured gold even as equities held up on a sharp rotation out of tech into defensive staples. Bitcoin extended its slide to fresh multi-week lows amid heavy deleveraging, while bonds eased in tandem with stocks, leaving staples as the lone pocket of relative calm.
tweet: A stronger dollar and rising real yields hit gold Friday, tech-to-staples rotation kept stocks afloat, and bitcoin hit fresh multi-week lows.
